name: pi-jev-permit
description: A Jev (TypeSafe System One) permission gate for the Pi coding agent: it judges every bash / write / edit call before it runs, behind a config allow/deny floor and a local read-only fast path.

scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types test/chain.test.ts test/policy.test.ts test/config.test.ts test/jev.test.ts test/gate.test.ts test/intent.test.ts test/rtk-compat.test.ts test/status.test.ts test/authorization.test.ts
